tools.name: sesame_token_info
tools.description: Show the company behind the API token: name, id, notification e-mail and language. Use it first to check the connection. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/info.

tools.name: sesame_list_employees
tools.description: List employees of the company (active by default) with contact, job and organisation fields. Filter by e-mail, code, national id, department, office or entity group. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/employees.

tools.name: sesame_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id, with the full profile. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/employees/{id}.

tools.name: sesame_list_departments
tools.description: List the company departments, optionally filtered by name. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/departments.

tools.name: sesame_list_offices
tools.description: List the company offices with address and coordinates. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/offices.

tools.name: sesame_list_locations
tools.description: List the company locations (geofenced places used for clock-in), with address, coordinates and radius. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/locations.

tools.name: sesame_list_roles
tools.description: List the roles that can be assigned to employees. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/roles.

tools.name: sesame_list_entity_groups
tools.description: List entity groups (teams or cost-centre groups), optionally for one employee or parent group. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/entity-groups.

tools.name: sesame_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the company custom fields (oldest first); option fields include their options. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/custom-fields.

tools.name: sesame_list_job_charges
tools.description: List the job charge levels of the company. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/job-charges.

tools.name: sesame_list_work_entries
tools.description: List clock-in and clock-out work entries of the company or one employee, with worked and break seconds. Filter by date range. Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/work-entries.

tools.name: sesame_list_check_incidences
tools.description: List check incidences (attendance exceptions that need review), with status (pending or revised) and employee. Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/check-incidences.

tools.name: sesame_list_worked_hours
tools.description: Report worked, due and balance seconds per employee for a date range. Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/reports/worked-hours.

tools.name: sesame_list_absence_requests
tools.description: List absence day-off requests (leave other than vacation) with status, days and resolution. Filter by employee, dates or status. Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/absence-day-off-requests.

tools.name: sesame_list_vacation_requests
tools.description: List vacation day-off requests with status, days and resolution. Filter by employee, dates or status. Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/vacation-day-off-requests.

tools.name: sesame_list_vacation_calendars
tools.description: List vacation calendars (one per employee and year) with the days off taken and the maximum allowed. Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/vacation-calendars.

tools.name: sesame_list_shifts
tools.description: List the shift definitions of the company (name, colour, time ranges). Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/shifts.

tools.name: sesame_list_shift_assignments
tools.description: List which shift each employee works on each date in a range (the planner). Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/shift-assignments.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "sesame_list_employees" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: email, code, integrationCode, dni, departmentIds, officeIds, entityGroupIds, limit, page, orderBy
